sources.note: 207 entries on main at inspection; file moved here from playwright-core/src/server. viewport = layout viewport after browser UI; screen = full screen in CSS px.

sources.quote: Apps don't control multitasking configurations or receive any indication of the ones that people choose.

sources.note: UIRequiresFullScreen deprecated in iPadOS 26; from iOS/iPadOS 27 the key no longer opts out of resizing. sizeRestrictions.minimumSize is a preferred minimum (example 500 pt); no system minimum or maximum window size published.

sources.quote: Chrome on Android will no longer resize the Layout Viewport
sources.note: Chrome 108 default interactive-widget=resizes-visual on Android; Safari iOS resizes visual viewport only; Firefox resizes both. No keyboard heights published.
Values computed by the corpus author from the other listed sources; each derived entry states its formula in `derivation`.

playwright deviceDescriptorsSource.json: iPad Pro 11 landscape (CSS px in Safari equal points)

usable.derivation: layout_viewport is the Playwright `viewport` (screen minus browser UI); insets 0 = no separate system-inset data published, not a claim of none
layout_viewport is the Playwright `viewport` (screen minus browser UI); insets 0 = no separate system-inset data published, not a claim of none

unknowns.reason: Playwright has no separate screen field for this entry, so viewport = screen (browser UI height unknown).

Stage Manager / windowed sizes are not published: apps receive no indication of the multitasking configuration (HIG) and sizeRestrictions.minimumSize is only a preferred minimum (TN3192, example 500 pt). Use `resize` transitions with explicit viewports and label them illustrative.
Apple scale factor not on the spec page; scale 2 and physical_px 1668x2388 from Playwright.
Hardware keyboard (Magic Keyboard) and trackpad are optional accessories; inputs record touch + soft keyboard only.
No published or cited community measurement of the soft keyboard height for this device; measure at test time (visualViewport.height delta or env(keyboard-inset-height)). Never defaulted.
